facts.fact: Identity Week says Kenya's birth e-service transfers data directly to the population registry.
Identity Week says births registered through the e-service, over 270,000 by September 2026, pass directly to the population registry.

Identity Week says the e-service enables hospital birth registrations that replace paper entries, with over 270,000 births recorded in two months to September 2026; the principal secretary said deaths could be added later.
Identity Week says ESTDEV funded the e-service's development under the European Union's human-centric digitalisation initiative.
